elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly states that Customer is subject to no restriction on soliciting any Vendor employee.
No mutual restriction is imposed; the clause instead eliminates any restriction on Customer and imposes none on Vendor.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: There is no operative mutual restriction or limitation tied to personnel directly involved in the Services.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: There is no operative mutual restriction, involvement-based trigger, or 12-month duration.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 permits hiring anyone who responds to general recruitment, and Section 12.4 imposes no solicitation or hiring restriction.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 imposes no restriction on soliciting, hiring, or employing Vendor employees, so unsolicited approaches are unrestricted.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: Sections 12.3 and 12.4 expressly confirm that Customer has no no-hire commitment or hiring restriction.
